__NOTOC__

'''Cupcakes''' are small individual cakes baked in cases. This recipe is for very simple, plain cakes. 

==Ingredients== 
*100 [[Cookbook:Gram|g]] [[Cookbook:Self-rising Flour|self-raising flour]]
*100 g [[Cookbook:Superfine Sugar|caster sugar]]
*100 g [[Cookbook:Margarine|margarine]]
*2 [[Cookbook:Each|ea]]. (100 g) [[Cookbook:Egg|eggs]]
*[[Cookbook:Powdered Sugar|Icing sugar]] (optional)
==Procedure==
[[Image:Fairy cakes in oven stage 1.jpg|thumb|Cupcakes baking in oven|308x308px]]
# Preheat an [[Cookbook:Oven|oven]] to {{#invoke:Temperature|gm|5}}.
# Place 15 [[Cookbook:Cupcake Liner|cupcake cases]] on a baking tray, or in a [[Cookbook:Muffin Pan|muffin/cupcake pan]] if you have one.
# Place flour, sugar, margarine and eggs into a mixing bowl. Use a electric mixer to mix the ingredients together for 1 minute.
# Use a spoon and knife to evenly dollop the batter into the cases.
# [[Cookbook:Baking|Bake]] for 15 to 20 minutes or until the cakes are golden and a [[Cookbook:Skewer|toothpick]] inserted in the center comes out clean.
# When completed remove from oven and leave to cool.
# Decorate with icing sugar if desired.

== Notes, tips, and variations ==

* Replace 2 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tablespoons]] of the flour with drinking chocolate or [[Cookbook:Cocoa|cocoa]] to add a nice chocolate flavor.
